metadata.title: Knowing the Noise by Name.
metadata.clock: narration (Kokoro af_bella) — per-beat mp3 durations are MEASURED, never estimated
metadata.greeting_note: hello lexicon: Swedish (Hej) — one of the short forms the HAI persona's word budget allows. Wagwan is Bear's only; not applicable to this channel.
metadata.purpose: Rebuild of the 20-beat vox-editorial reel at claude-for-astronomy/gravitational-wave-detection/ as an ai-explainer reel on the claude-hai channel. Same subject (LIGO's Gravity Spy glitch classifier; GW170817's near miss as the cold-open stakes), re-authored to the ai-explainer spine (Claude composer cold open -> presenter -> BLUF -> body -> verdict -> YOUR TURN -> title restate) and rewritten from the Vox-editorial voice into the Pragmatist register: method, when to use it, and where it fails. Facts carried from the source reel's FACTCHECK.md (verified 2026-08-08, primary sources cited per claim) — see FACTCHECK.md and SOURCES.md here.
metadata.color_semantics: Claude fidelity palette. Terracotta #D97757 is the ONE accent and marks exactly one focal event per beat: the glitch, the counter's target, the misread, the unnamed class. Ink #3D3929 carries everything else. No second hue is introduced for 'signal vs noise' — the accent moves, the meaning does not.
metadata.note: ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00 (cold open, with RESULT lines), B11 (verdict artifact), B12 (handoff), B13 (title outro). Every other beat illustrates its concept as a reel-local Manim scene (scenes.py) in the Claude fidelity palette. No LaTeX/MathTex anywhere — this machine has no dvisvgm, and nothing in the reel needs typeset math. metadata.channel_title is deliberately omitted: compile.py's bottom-centre overlay sits below the title-safe inset and trips GATE V edge-bleed; the channel is carried by the composer folder chip, a per-scene wordmark bug, and the full-size handle on the outro (see BUILD-LOG.md).
